raw_response:
My reasoning as this farmer:

I am 70, been working this 10.1 mu for 20 years. Wheat in winter, maize in summer — that is what we do here in Quzhou, like everyone. I do not change much from year to year. What worked last year will work this year. Changing things is how you lose money.

For wheat, I sow in October after the maize comes off. I use improved seed — the county dealer sells Jimai or Shiluan, whatever he has. I buy the same kind my neighbor Old Wang buys, he gets good harvest. Before sowing I plow with the tractor (rent the service, about 40 yuan per mu). I put down 2 bags of compound fertilizer (15-15-15, 50 kg each) per mu at sowing, that is one hundred jin per mu — my father taught me, compound at the bottom, urea on top later. Then at jointing in March I spread 1 bag of urea per mu, about 40 jin. Some years I add a bit more urea if the leaves look yellow. Too little fertilizer and the grain is thin, that is worse than spending extra money.

Water — my well is good. Wheat needs winter water before freeze, then jointing water, then filling water. Three times. If spring is dry I add one more. Pesticide — I spray once for aphids in April, once for wheat scab at heading if the weather is wet. Two times usually enough.

Wheat yield — last year I got about 900 jin per mu (450 kg), same this year if weather holds.

For maize in June, right after wheat harvest. No time to plow, I direct-seed into the stubble with the seeder — no-till, saves money and time. I use hybrid seed, Zhengdan or Denghai, whatever the dealer recommends. At sowing I put 1 bag compound (50kg of 15-15-15) per mu, plus half bag urea at big flare (about 25kg). Total urea about half-bag more than wheat because maize grows fast and summer rain washes fertilizer.

Maize usually gets enough summer rain, so I irrigate only once or twice if July-August is dry. Pesticide twice — once for corn borer, once for armyworm if I see them. Maize yield about 1,100 jin per mu (550 kg), that is my usual.

My wife helps at sowing and harvest. My son comes back for busy days. Four of us in the house, we eat some of the maize and wheat, sell the rest. Every bag of fertilizer is 130 yuan, I count carefully but I do not cut — cutting fertilizer is cutting yield, that is stupid.
